name: v6.3.2
body:
v6.3.2: Home Screen Upgrades, Core Refactoring & Zcash Updates

This release brings major quality-of-life improvements directly to your home screen, alongside critical under-the-hood upgrades to our core engine and how the wallet handles transaction values.

What’s New:

📜 Home Screen Transaction History: No more digging through menus. You can now view your recent transaction history directly on the main home screen for quick, at-a-glance monitoring.

🎯 Smarter Alias Resolution: We’ve significantly improved how the wallet handles sending to aliases (like OpenAlias, ENS, and Unstoppable Domains), ensuring addresses resolve quickly and accurately.

🧮 Precision Amount Handling: We completely refactored how the app calculates and displays crypto amounts. This eliminates edge-case decimal bugs and ensures exact precision when typing or converting values.

🌐 Radar Integration: Radar is now fully integrated into the Apps screen, giving you easier access directly within the wallet.

🛡️ Zcash Upgrades: We've updated our Zcash integration to ensure faster syncing, better stability, and alignment with the latest network standards.

🛍️ Cake Pay Mobile Enhancements: Buying gift cards and spending crypto via Cake Pay is now faster and smoother with UI and flow improvements.

🏗️ Flutter Engine Upgrade: We’ve bumped the underlying Flutter framework to the latest version, paired with the next major phase of our codebase refactoring. The result is a noticeably snappier and more responsive app.

🛠️ Bug Fixes: Routine maintenance and UI polish across the board.

name: v6.2.1
body:
Version 6.2.1 delivers one of our most requested security integrations alongside an across-the-board upgrade to our advanced user tools. We’re pairing hardware-grade cold storage for Monero with redesigned interfaces for Web3 dApps and node management.

What’s New:

🔒 Trezor Hardware Support for Monero: Take your privacy to the next level. You can now pair your Trezor device to manage, view, and safely sign Monero (XMR) transactions while keeping your private keys entirely offline.

🌐 Redesigned WalletConnect UI: Interacting with dApps is now simpler and more transparent. The updated interface gives you clearer permission prompts, faster session initializations, and smoother multi-chain Web3 connections.

🛰️ New Nodes Screen: We've completely overhauled the custom nodes interface. It's now easier to view node latency, switch between custom or default daemons, and manage your connections to Bitcoin, Litecoin, and Monero networks.

⚡ Optimized BTC/LTC Syncing: No more staring at progress bars. We’ve optimized background synchronization for Bitcoin and Litecoin wallets, meaning faster load times when opening the app.

🛍️ "Pay Anything" Enhancements: We've refined the payment flow mechanics, making it slicker to scan, convert, and pay any crypto invoice instantly.

🏗️ Under-the-Hood Refactoring: Parts of our ongoing codebase modernization have been deployed, resulting in a lighter app footprint and better memory management.

🛠️ Bug Fixes: General maintenance and performance tweaks to squash edge-case UI glitches.

# Release Notes

v6.1.2: Smoother Performance & USDT Bridging

Following our major v6.0.0 milestone, version 6.1.2 is all about refinement. We’ve focused on the "feel" of the app—making it faster and more stable—while adding a powerful new tool for stablecoin users: native USDT bridging.

What’s New:

🌉 USDT Bridging: You can now bridge USDT between supported chains directly within the app. Whether you need to move liquidity between Ethereum, Polygon, or Arbitrum, our integrated bridging makes it seamless and secure.

🚀 Performance Enhancements: We’ve optimized the core engine to make the new v6.0 design even snappier. Navigation is smoother, and asset screens load faster than ever.

🏗️ Wallet Stability: We’ve improved the background handling of multi-chain wallets, ensuring that your balances and transaction histories stay perfectly in sync across all networks.

🛠️ Bug Fixes: This update squashes several bugs identified after the v6.0 launch, particularly regarding Lightning invoice generation and EVM connectivity.

body:
# Release Notes

v6.0.1: The Future of Cake is Here — New Look, New Lightning!

Welcome to the next chapter of Cake Wallet. Version 6.0.1 is more than just an update; it’s a complete evolution of the wallet you trust. We’ve redesigned everything from the ground up and finally brought high-speed Bitcoin payments to your pocket.

What’s New:

✨ A Bold New Design: We’ve reimagined the entire user experience. Our new interface is cleaner, faster, and more intuitive, making it easier than ever to manage your Monero and other assets while maintaining the privacy-first feel you love.

⚡ Bitcoin Lightning via Spark: Fast, cheap Bitcoin payments have arrived! We’ve integrated the Spark protocol, a next-gen Bitcoin Layer 2.

Instant Transactions: Send and receive Bitcoin in seconds.

Low Fees: Skip the high L1 costs for daily purchases.

Natively Interoperable: Seamlessly bridge between your on-chain Bitcoin and the Lightning Network.

🛠️ Under-the-Hood Performance: With v6.0.1, we’ve optimized our core engine to ensure that even with a fresh coat of paint, your Monero syncing and transaction speeds remain best-in-class.
